data.narrative:
HEO, a Series A-stage space and aerospace company founded by Dr. Will Crowe and Dr. Hiranya Jayakody, has raised $12M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 5 public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and ICEYE, though the peer set spans a wide stage range from Seed through Series B.

Two triangulation methods are applicable given available data. Stage-progression analysis, using the $12M raised as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 2.0x Series A step-up multiplier, implies a valuation of $24M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector comparables—Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B, Series B), Aalyria ($1.3B, Series B), and Starcloud ($1.1B, Seed)—yields a median of $1.3B, with a range of $1.1B to $2.0B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied, as HEO's revenue is not disclosed. The public Space & Aerospace sector median trades at 24.6x P/S, but without revenue visibility this method remains inapplicable.

The triangulated range is $20M (low) to $1.5B (high), with a median of $662M across the two methods. This wide spread reflects stage and maturity heterogeneity in the peer set. Key uncertainties include HEO's near-term revenue trajectory, capital intensity, and technical differentiation relative to well-funded competitors. Valuation tightens materially once operating metrics become available.
